parallels.note: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

people.name: Arpachshad
people.line: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Shelah
people.line: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
translations.bsb: And after he had become the father of Shelah, Arphaxad lived 403 years and had other sons and daughters.
translations.kjv: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
translations.asv: and Arpachshad lived after he begat Shelah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
